regulations.enforcement_body: Honolulu Department of Planning and Permitting
regulations.notes: Honolulu passed Ordinance 22-7, increasing minimum rental period from 30 to 90 days in most residential areas. STRs under 90 days are only permitted in resort-zoned areas and certain apartment-zoned areas with a Non-Conforming Use Certificate (NUC). Act 17 (2024 state law) gave Honolulu power to phase out STRs outside resort areas. Beginning September 2025, non-NUC residential rentals must have a minimum 90-day rental term.
